item.title: Bad Bunny deletes everything on Instagram, except one link
item.description: Bad Bunny’s Instagram is suddenly empty after his Super Bowl halftime show, with just one album link left behind.

item.title: NASA, SpaceX reschedules Crew-12 launch for Feb 12
item.description: NASA and SpaceX have rescheduled the launch of the Crew-12 mission to the International Space Station to no earlier than 5:38 a.m. EST Thursday, Feb. 12, due to unfavorable weather conditions.

item.title: Expand Energy is the latest company to move their headquarters from Oklahoma to Houston
item.description: Expand Energy Corporation is moving its executive headquarters from Oklahoma City to Houston by 2026.

item.title: Last 2 civil lawsuits alleging sexual assault by Browns QB Deshaun Watson dismissed
item.description: Court records show these lawsuits involved accusations of sexual misconduct from 27 women, mostly during massage appointments.

item.title: FBI says it's unaware of Savannah Guthrie talking with her mom's suspected kidnappers
item.description: Savannah Guthrie said her family is at their “hour of desperation” in the search for their apparently kidnapped mother, but made no mention of possible ransom in a new video released Monday just hours before a ransom deadline.

item.title: 'Mattress Mack' takes another big gambling loss in Super Bowl LX
item.description: Mattress Mack made another big bet on the Super Bowl, but he ended up losing millions of dollars.

item.title: 'Purge them from our classrooms': Behind the push to oust Texas teachers who commented on Charlie Kirk
item.description: KXAN reviewed every record we could find of educators facing allegations of "inappropriate" comments about Kirk. Records we obtained show for weeks following his assassination, Texas educators were reported, reprimanded, fired, threatened and doxed online over posts some believed celebrated his death.

item.title: Baytown man arrested, charged with murder of Louisiana man, police say
item.description: A man was arrested and charged with the murder of a Louisiana man in Baytown, police said.

item.title: Cedar pollen spikes, more to come this week
item.description: If you’re sneezing, congested, and exhausted in Houston, it may not be a cold. Cedar fever is peaking as pollen rides in on cold fronts.

item.title: FBI billboards go up in Houston in search for Nancy Guthrie
item.description: Federal investigators use digital billboards in Houston to generate leads in the search for Nancy Guthrie. Public assistance is crucial.
